admin_commit_policy.author_and_committer_timestamps: both must parse and lie within inclusive [PLAN.created_utc,campaign_deadline_utc]
admin_commit_policy.bounded_worktree_inputs_must_equal_head: descriptor-pinned single-link reads of the three admin paths and every source/bootstrap/historical/preflight/binding/full-plan input compared to exact HEAD blobs and Git 100644 modes; no Git status or worktree diff is invoked
admin_commit_policy.exact_regular_file_mode: 100644 Git blob/index and live 0644 for every admin/source/bootstrap input
admin_commit_policy.global_worktree_status_before_claim: forbidden, including bounded status, because Git could hash worktree content before producer single-link validation

host_runtime.policy: live host and runtime must exactly equal the frozen f537 binding before every claim and after every gate

decision_policy.clock_or_wall_monotonic_failure: terminal-development-clock-rollback-rejection; report and decision remain replayable; no rerun
decision_policy.first_failed_stage: terminal-development-rejection only when chronology and campaign interval are valid
decision_policy.stage_clock_semantics: each structurally canonical execution receipt remains loadable even when its observed clock is invalid; stage_chronology_valid requires claim<=start<=end<=report plus absolute wall-versus-monotonic elapsed disagreement <=5.0 seconds and monotonic elapsed <=run_timeout_seconds+5.0 seconds
decision_policy.stage_interval_semantics: stage_within_campaign_interval requires claim/start/end/report all inside inclusive [created_utc,campaign_deadline_utc]
decision_policy.wall_clock_rollback: any report chronology or wall/monotonic failure, or decision rollback, produces terminal-development-clock-rollback-rejection; decision_chronology_valid=false; never selected

evidence_boundary.audit_write_policy: sys.dont_write_bytecode=true before local imports; audit creates no directories, claims, locks, fsyncs, reports, decisions, gate subprocesses, or bank reads; Git optional locks are disabled
evidence_boundary.authoring_reads: content-addressed reports, plans, source/configuration files, build dependency records, and process metadata only
evidence_boundary.candidate_selection_basis: pre-heldout nested proof-scope matrix and its pre-heldout mask3 fallback designation
evidence_boundary.finite_bootstrap_assumption: trusted infrastructure is limited to the frozen interpreter/runtime, stdlib host introspection (including platform.platform and platform.mac_ver), import and dynamic-loader machinery, fixed-checkout old_full/common executable modules, repo Git metadata/index/config, and explicitly invoked sealed-system /usr/bin/git tooling; Apple /usr/bin/python3 and /usr/bin/otool may legitimately share a multi-link sealed-system inode, although the actual frozen Homebrew Python runtime is single-link and identity-bound and only exact hash/mode-bound /usr/bin/otool uses the validated-data multi-link exception; after import, all other producer-managed repo/build/result/dependency data and registry reads follow the descriptor-pinned single-link policy; hostile lock-path replacement is bounded by the post-six-lock identity revalidation boundary
evidence_boundary.fixed_input_read_policy: all explicitly validated source, configuration, plan, historical evidence, binary, artifact, depfile, and registry bytes are descriptor reads using O_RDONLY|O_NOFOLLOW with path/inode stability and single-link enforcement; the only multi-link exception is the exact hash/mode-bound sealed-OS /usr/bin/otool executable; both lexical and resolved compiler dependency paths ending in .tsv are rejected before content access
evidence_boundary.git_read_policy: GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0; commit-object operations and one cached-index diff scoped to the literal exact non-bank bounded path set; no Git status or worktree diff; producer worktree authority comes only from descriptor-pinned single-link reads compared to exact HEAD blobs/index/tree 100644 modes, with source/bootstrap inputs also compared to c807
evidence_boundary.host_runtime_reads: exact frozen f537 host/runtime record rederived live with /usr/sbin/sysctl; host, runtime, and inspector identities enter stable evidence and the qualification key
evidence_boundary.prior_heldout_result_use: campaign-closure fact only; no score, color, timing, or opening detail may tune this campaign
evidence_boundary.producer_bootstrap_binding: the two imported repo-local helper modules have separate exact byte/mode/SHA identities, equal c807 and admin HEAD/index/tree blobs, and their canonical identity-map digest enters stable evidence and the qualification key
evidence_boundary.stderr_retention: never retained; only byte count, SHA-256, and empty flag are persisted
evidence_boundary.stdout_retention: raw text retained only when it has the exact six-line non-transcript bank-summary/aggregate/configuration schema required for crash recovery; otherwise only byte count, SHA-256, and retained=false are persisted
evidence_boundary.tracked_fixed_evidence: historical reports/matrix/full-development selection, full-development plan, and frozen preflight receipt are descriptor-pinned live 0644 single-link reads; the frozen f537 binding and closed 9c12 decision are descriptor-pinned live 0444 single-link reads; every input equals its frozen digest and exact HEAD/index 100644 blob before use

one_shot_policy.crash_recovery: a pre-existing durable execution receipt without a report is conservatively finalized as an interrupted-postflight DEVELOPMENT rejection without rerunning the gate or refreshing evidence; a claim without an execution receipt is spent and cannot rerun
one_shot_policy.deadline: a stage is acceptable only when stage_chronology_valid and stage_within_campaign_interval are true; exact order is claim<=gate start<=gate end<=report and all four plus any selected decision are inside the inclusive campaign interval; report/decision clock failures are durable terminal rejections
one_shot_policy.durability: registry mkdir followed by unconditional parent-directory fsync, including on restart; new claims/executions/reports/decisions are O_EXCL, fchmod 0444 single-link regular files, then file- and parent-directory-fsynced; PLAN and lock files are 0644 single-link regular files, with new locks fchmod 0644 independent of umask; after all six locks are flocked, each pathname is rebound to its held descriptor inode before evidence work; recovery validates every exact current-candidate/content filename and captures its device/inode before any record read or fsync; every producer-managed fixed input and registry record (with the sole exact sealed-OS /usr/bin/otool multi-link exception) has each semantic read performed through O_RDONLY|O_NOFOLLOW, with regular/single-link policy and stable device, inode, size, mode, link count, and pathname identity checked before and after descriptor reads; reports reuse the one captured raw buffer for stage dispatch and semantic replay; pre-existing content-addressed files remain inode-pinned across durability repair and comparison
one_shot_policy.execution_receipt: canonical O_EXCL receipt persisted immediately after a gate returns; structurally valid receipts remain loadable when observed timestamp order, wall/monotonic agreement, deadline, or outcome semantics fail so a deterministic unacceptable report and terminal decision can be persisted without rerun
one_shot_policy.immediate_preclaim_process_record: last read-only check before O_EXCL; checked within 60 seconds of and no later than claim, after every predecessor report; persisted exactly in claim, execution receipt, and report
one_shot_policy.lock_interval: all six locks held continuously in the listed deterministic order across complete evidence, immediate process refresh, claim, gate, execution receipt, report, and decision
one_shot_policy.postflight_failure: any ordinary postflight exception is immediately recorded digest-only; any interruption after the durable execution receipt but before a durable report becomes a deterministic interrupted-postflight rejection on recovery, so observed drift/error can never be erased by restoration
one_shot_policy.report_and_decision_format: canonical-content-addressed-json; every newly persisted decision is semantically replayed, then the complete registries are rescanned to require it as the sole exact decision before CLI return
one_shot_policy.report_evidence: full stable before/after evidence maps plus their canonical SHA-256 digests

stages.purpose: directly isolate removal of the ply1 exact-proof scope from the rejected mask7 configuration
preserve the pre-heldout fallback's absolute same-binary mask0 check
require absolute strength against the exact Rank4 incumbent

thresholds_each_stage.structural_accounting: exact bank/color/engine/proof/timing aggregation; finite bounded averages; nodes average equals nodes/searches to printed 0.001 precision; nodes p99<=nodes max<=both total nodes and the 3000000 configured per-search budget; attempted depth>=completed depth; overruns/exhaustions bounded
